## script.add

Attaches a script class of the loaded module to an entity, optionally overriding fields (undoable; while playing it changes the running copy only and the script starts at once). Needs a loaded module (script.build) to check the class and field types.

Kind: `Edit` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `scripts` · Answers later (MayDefer): no · Waits for the asset scan: yes · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorScriptCommands.cpp:572`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `class` | string | yes |   | Script class name as registered with ST\_SCRIPT\_CLASS (see script.status). |
| `entity` | string | yes |   | Entity (entity ID). Pattern: `^[0-9A-Fa-f]{1,16}$`. |
| `fields` | object | no |   | Field overrides by name, e.g. {&quot;Speed&quot;: 2.5, &quot;Target&quot;: &quot;&lt;entity id&gt;&quot;, &quot;Prefab&quot;: &quot;Prefabs/Bullet.stprefab&quot;}. |

## script.build

Builds the project's scripts (the CMakeLists.txt in its Scripts directory) with the engine's compiler and configuration, then loads the module, or hot-reloads it when it changed (playing scenes keep their script state and get OnReload). One build runs at a time; a second request fails while one runs. Fails with the first compiler errors; the result and script.status list all diagnostics (file, line, message) and the end of the build log.

Kind: `Edit` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `core`, `scripts` · Answers later (MayDefer): yes · Waits for the asset scan: yes · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorScriptCommands.cpp:314`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `wait` | boolean | no |   | Return when the build finished, with its result (default true); false returns at once (poll script.status). |

## script.create

Writes a new script class into the project's script directory: a .cpp with the class (deriving from Script), its ST\_SCRIPT\_CLASS registration and, with the behaviour template (default), OnCreate, OnUpdate and an example field (Speed) or the fields given. The class name must be a C++ identifier that neither the project's scripts nor the SDK declare. Creates the script build first when the project has none (script.init). Build it with script.build before attaching it (script.add accepts classes of the loaded module only); afterwards play.start rebuilds sources that changed. Returns the file written (absolute and relative to the project) and the class.

Kind: `Edit` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `scripts` · Answers later (MayDefer): no · Waits for the asset scan: yes · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorScriptCommands.cpp:417`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `class` | string | yes |   | The class name, a C++ identifier, e.g. PlayerController. |
| `fields` | object | no |   | Fields to declare, by name, with their type: bool, int, float, vec2, vec3, vec4, quat, string, entity, asset (case does not matter), e.g. {&quot;Speed&quot;: &quot;float&quot;, &quot;Target&quot;: &quot;entity&quot;}. |
| `open` | boolean | no |   | Also open the new file in the external editor (default false). |
| `path` | string | no |   | Where to write it, relative to the script directory and ending in .cpp (default: &lt;class&gt;.cpp); folders are created. |
| `template` | string | no |   | behaviour (default): OnCreate, OnUpdate and fields; empty: only the class and its registration. One of: `behaviour`, `empty`. |

## script.get

The field values of the scripts attached to an entity. While the game plays they are the live instances' values (game state kept in fields, e.g. a score, as it is now; live: true); otherwise the values the scene stores (overrides, else the class defaults). known: false means the loaded module has no such class, so only stored overrides are listed. Optionally one class.

## script.init

Creates the project's script build if it is missing: the CMakeLists.txt in its Scripts directory (new projects have it already), the CMakePresets.json IDEs read (the engine's toolchain and STRATA\_ENGINE\_DIR, for IntelliSense; rewritten when Strata wrote it and the toolchain changed) and, with example, an example script (Spinner.cpp). Other existing files are kept. Returns the files written.

## script.list

Lists the project's script sources, the files the script build compiles: the code and CMake files of its script directory (folders starting with '.' and build trees left out), sorted by path, each with the script classes it registers (ST\_SCRIPT\_CLASS) and its size. Use it to find the file that holds a class before changing it (script.open opens one in the person's code editor). Returns sourceDirectory, files \[{path (relative to the script directory), projectPath (relative to the project), classes, bytes}\] and truncated (more files than listed, or the folder could not be listed completely).

Kind: `Query` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `scripts` · Answers later (MayDefer): no · Waits for the asset scan: no · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorScriptCommands.cpp:258`

## script.open

Opens a script source in the person's code editor at a line (e.g. a compiler diagnostic or a crash location from script.status): the external editor command (script.setExternalEditor, or STRATA\_EXTERNAL\_EDITOR), else the system's default application for the file. Without file, the project's script directory opens. Only code, CMake and text files of the project or the engine. Returns what opened it.

## script.setExternalEditor

Sets the person's code editor, which script.open, the Problems panel and crash reports use: a command template such as &quot;code -g {file}:{line}:{column}&quot; or &quot;\\&quot;C:/Program Files/.../devenv.exe\\&quot; /Edit {file}&quot; (whitespace separates arguments, double quotes group them; {file}, {line}, {column} and {directory} are filled in; without {file} the file goes last). The program runs directly, never through a shell: a path, or a name found in PATH (VS Code's code launcher starts Code.exe), not a .cmd or .bat; a program that is not there is refused. An empty command goes back to the default application. Kept in the person's preferences (the Editor.ExternalEditor section of preferences.get, not the project); STRATA\_EXTERNAL\_EDITOR overrides it. Returns the command in use and the program the person's command starts (program).

Kind: `Session` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `scripts` · Answers later (MayDefer): no · Waits for the asset scan: no · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorScriptCommands.cpp:540`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `command` | string | yes |   | The command template, or empty for none. |

## script.setField

Overrides one field of a script attached to an entity, or resets it to the class default with value null (undoable; while playing it changes the running copy and the live script at once). The value must fit the field's type (see script.status): bool, integer, number, \[x, y\] / \[x, y, z\] / \[x, y, z, w\] arrays, quaternions as \[x, y, z, w\] or Euler degrees \[pitch, yaw, roll\], text, an entity ID, or an asset handle or path. Needs a loaded module (script.build) to check the field.

Kind: `Edit` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `scripts` · Answers later (MayDefer): no · Waits for the asset scan: yes · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/EditorScriptCommands.cpp:635`

## script.status

The project's scripts: the loaded module (path, load count, hot reload), its classes with their fields (name, type, default) and implemented callbacks, the current crash fault and the last one that stopped play mode, the running and last build (with compiler diagnostics and the toolchain it used), and the toolchain the next build uses (an installed editor finds one on this machine at its first build: toolchain.found).
